items.headline: Gale Watch issued September 23 at 1:01PM PDT until September 25 at 11:00AM PDT by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...Seas 7 to 12 ft at 10 seconds and south winds 25 to 35
kt with gusts up to 40 kt possible.

* WHERE...Coastal Waters from Cape Shoalwater to Florence out 60
NM.

* WHEN...From Thursday evening through Friday morning.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds can cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...20-40% chance of wind gusts over 40 kt.
items.instruction:
A Gale Watch is issued when the risk of gale force winds of 34 to
47 knots has significantly increased, but the specific timing
and/or location is still uncertain. It is intended to provide
additional lead time for mariners who may wish to consider
altering their plans.
